The main takeaway from our work is that
the types of allergen exposures that children experience vary by socioeconomic status.
the types of allergen exposures in inner-city homes may vary considerably from exposures in suburban or rural homes.
the types of allergen exposures that are most common in homes of children at risk for asthma are highly variable.
